Appam & Vegetable Stew.alt: AI-illustrated Appam & Vegetable Stew: Two lacy Kerala appam pancakes with soft white centres on charcoal ceramic, and a small ivory bowl of coconut-milk vegetable stew with potato, carrot, beans and curry leaves.

Beef Ularthiyathu.alt: AI-illustrated Beef Ularthiyathu: Kerala dry-roasted beef pieces, dark richly caramelised spice crust, toasted coconut slivers and fresh curry leaves on a shallow charcoal ceramic plate. Dry roast, no liquid curry.

Karimeen Pollichathu.alt: AI-illustrated Karimeen Pollichathu: One cooked pearl spot fish coated with reddish shallot masala inside a neatly opened roasted banana leaf, elegantly presented on an oval dark ceramic plate. The entire fish and leaf visible.

Thalassery Chicken Biryani.alt: AI-illustrated Thalassery Chicken Biryani: Thalassery biryani with distinctly short-grain white and golden kaima rice, tender chicken, crisp fried shallots and mint, served in a refined dark ceramic bowl.

Malabar Prawn Curry.alt: AI-illustrated Malabar Prawn Curry: Five plump cooked prawns in a glossy golden-orange coconut curry, fresh curry leaves and a little coconut cream, served in a shallow handmade charcoal bowl.

Chicken Biryani.alt: AI-illustrated Chicken Biryani: Fragrant long-grain basmati chicken biryani, individual white and saffron-gold rice grains, one beautifully cooked chicken drumstick, fried onions and mint in a hammered antique brass handi.

Butter Chicken.alt: AI-illustrated Butter Chicken: Tender chicken pieces in velvety orange tomato and butter sauce with a restrained cream swirl and dried fenugreek, in a refined charcoal ceramic bowl.

Tandoori Chicken.alt: AI-illustrated Tandoori Chicken: Two yoghurt-and-spice marinated tandoori chicken legs with natural russet-red spice crust and authentic dark char marks, lime wedge, sliced onion and coriander on a charcoal ceramic plate. No artificial red colouring.

Palak Paneer.alt: AI-illustrated Palak Paneer: Soft ivory paneer cubes in vibrant deep green spinach sauce, subtle cream swirl and tiny toasted cumin seeds in a handmade charcoal bowl.

Dal Makhani.alt: AI-illustrated Dal Makhani: Glossy slow-cooked black lentils and red kidney beans in a rich dark brown sauce, fine cream swirl and small pat of melting butter, in a charcoal ceramic bowl.

Risotto ai Funghi.alt: AI-illustrated Risotto ai Funghi: Creamy mushroom risotto spread elegantly in a wide ivory shallow bowl, identifiable plump rice grains, sautéed mixed woodland mushrooms, restrained parmesan shavings and fresh thyme.

Spaghetti Carbonara.alt: AI-illustrated Spaghetti Carbonara: A precise loose nest of spaghetti coated in glossy pale golden egg and pecorino sauce, crisp guanciale pieces and cracked black pepper on a wide ivory ceramic plate. No cream puddle or red sauce.

Lasagna al Forno.alt: AI-illustrated Lasagna al Forno: One beautifully cut square of baked lasagna with visible layers of pasta, meat ragù and béchamel, a golden browned top and a little rich tomato sauce on an ivory ceramic plate.

Pizza Margherita.alt: AI-illustrated Pizza Margherita: A whole small authentic Neapolitan margherita pizza with airy blistered crust, red tomato, pools of white mozzarella, fresh basil and olive oil, on a simple dark ceramic platter. Entire round pizza visible.

Tiramisu.alt: AI-illustrated Tiramisu: A single elegant rectangular tiramisu slice, clearly visible layers of coffee-soaked sponge fingers and mascarpone cream, cocoa-dusted top, on a minimal ivory dessert plate.

Herb-Roasted Sea Bass.alt: AI-illustrated Herb-Roasted Sea Bass: One cooked sea bass fillet with crisp bronzed skin, small roasted baby carrots, tender green vegetables and delicate herb butter sauce on a wide charcoal ceramic plate. Refined restaurant plating.

Croquette.alt: AI-illustrated Croquette: Exactly two spherical golden breadcrumb croquettes on a large ivory plate. Preserve the supplied plating reference: intersecting dark glossy triangular sauce shapes outlined in pale golden purée, one small green herb-oil inset. Elegant geometric layout, no invented filling.

Beef Bourguignon.alt: AI-illustrated Beef Bourguignon: Slow-braised beef in a glossy dark red-wine sauce with pearl onions, browned mushrooms and thyme, served over a small silky potato purée in a refined shallow charcoal bowl.

Beef Wellington.alt: AI-illustrated Beef Wellington: Two neatly sliced portions of beef Wellington with medium-rare rose centre, thin dark mushroom duxelles and crisp golden puff pastry, a small pool of glossy jus on an ivory plate. Realistic pastry and beef.

Crème Brûlée.alt: AI-illustrated Crème Brûlée: A single ivory ramekin of vanilla crème brûlée with a delicate amber caramelised sugar crust, one small section cracked to reveal silky custard, on an ivory saucer.

Lamb Mandi.alt: AI-illustrated Lamb Mandi: A tender slow-roasted lamb shank on fluffy long-grain golden Arabian spiced rice, a few toasted almonds and herbs in an elegant shallow dark ceramic platter. Whole shank and serving vessel visible.

Chicken Shawarma.alt: AI-illustrated Chicken Shawarma: Beautifully charred thin slices of chicken shawarma with warm folded flatbread, a little pickled cucumber, pink turnip pickles and a neat ivory garlic-toum sauce accent on a dark oval ceramic plate. No sandwich wrapper.

Falafel.alt: AI-illustrated Falafel: Five crisp deep-golden falafel, one halved to reveal a vivid green herb and chickpea centre, with tahini sauce, fresh parsley and a little chopped salad on a dark ceramic plate.

Hummus.alt: AI-illustrated Hummus: Silky hummus in a wide ivory shallow bowl, sculpted spiral with golden olive oil, a few whole chickpeas, a small dusting of paprika and fresh parsley. Restrained, sophisticated mezze presentation.

Kunafa.alt: AI-illustrated Kunafa: One round individual kunafa with delicate deeply golden shredded kataifi pastry, a little melted white cheese visible at the cut edge, finely chopped green pistachios and a light syrup sheen on an ivory dessert plate.
